events.title: Fei-Fei Li co-directs Stanford HAI launch
events.summary: Stanford launched the Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence on March 18, 2019 with Fei-Fei Li as co-director — bridging CS, humanities, and policy.
events.about: HAI united ~200 faculty across disciplines to study AI's societal impact, not just algorithms. Li's leadership positioned human-centered design and ethics alongside technical breakthroughs at a top research university.

narrative.whyChosen: HAI institutionalized interdisciplinary AI governance at Stanford scale.
narrative.whyImportant: It modeled how universities could study AI's human impact, not just capabilities.
narrative.problemSolved: AI research silos lacked forums connecting engineering, ethics, and public policy.
